messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-784122 - GPU memory pressure detected in pool=inference-prod-eu-west-1. Rule: cuda.alloc.failures rate > 5/min.

incident-bot: Summary: ~60% of gpus in pool reporting CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL / OOM on node set rtx-pool-04. Link: https://metrics.redwood.ai/alerts/PD-784122 :rotating_light:

sophie_oncall: acking PD-784122. I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking impact.

miguel_rtx: thx. I'll check kernel logs and kvcache metrics. suspecting fragmentation on 48G cards after a big eval batch.

sophie_oncall: seeing increased 5xxs from hosted inference in eu-west. Customer-facing error spike ~8% failures, latency P95 up from 210ms -> 1.2s. Will start routing away from that pool.

tara_sre: if we can isolate nodes with high vmem use, we should cordon/drain and fallback to spillover pool. I can kick off cordon.

sophie_oncall: plan: 1) cordon rtx-pool-04 nodes with highest OOMs 2) scale up spare-inference-pool (if autoscale doesn't) 3) reroute traffic via routing policy to fallback models 4) restart driver on affected nodes after eviction.

miguel_rtx: collecting nvml dumps. snippet from /var/log/syslog: 

```
Mar 22 23:12:01 rtx-pool-04-n12 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 22 23:12:01 rtx-pool-04-n12 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, Ecc error
Mar 22 23:12:02 rtx-pool-04-n12 cuda: CUDA_ALLOC_FAILED: out of memory while allocating 2147483648 bytes
```

miguel_rtx: not a driver crash exactly, more repeated alloc failures and fragmentation. KVCACHE eviction rates spiked.

sophie_oncall: I'm running this to identify nodes with >3 alloc failures in last 10m: 

```
# list nodes by alloc failure count
kubectl -n infra top nodes --selector=pool=rtx-pool-04 | awk '{print $1}'
# fallback: query metrics API
curl -s 'https://metrics.redwood.ai/query?metric=cuda_alloc_failures&pool=rtx-pool-04&window=10m' | jq '.'
```

jamal_support: flagged customer-impact in the incident docket. Notifying customers with active sessions in eu-west via status page banner.

deploy-bot: Found 4 active canary deploys on rtx-pool-04 - recommend pausing new rollouts.

sophie_oncall: paused canaries. Tara, can you cordon rtx-pool-04-n09 and rtx-pool-04-n12? Those two have highest error counts.

tara_sre: cordoned rtx-pool-04-n09/n12. Starting drain: `kubectl drain rtx-pool-04-n12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

miguel_rtx: while draining, increase KV cache eviction threshold so surviving pods don't thrash. Pushed a quick feature flag to runtime: `KVCACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=1e6` in fallback pool.

sophie_oncall: traffic rerouting in progress: routing-policy set to prefer pool=inference-spare-eu with 95% weight, fallback to model-quantized if necessary.

incident-bot: PD-784122 updated: acknowledged by sophie_oncall at 1832109880. Status: investigating.

jamal_support: updating customers: "We're investigating elevated errors for inference in eu-west. Engineers are rerouting traffic; some requests may be delayed. No data loss reported."

miguel_rtx: after cordon + drain, OOM count on pool dropped 70% in 5m. Kernel Xid 79 entries still present but less frequent.

sophie_oncall: attempted graceful restart of n12 driver: `systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced` then `modprobe -r nvidia && modprobe nvidia`. Observed one node come back healthy, one required node reboot.

tara_sre: node rtx-pool-04-n12 required reboot. Scheduling next maintenance window for full driver update, but for now it's back in rotation.

miguel_rtx: root cause hypothesis: large batched eval workload triggered fragmentation + kvcache spike -> repeated small allocs failing. Follow-ups: kernel update to 540.x, adjust allocator, increase prefetch memory in runtime.

sophie_oncall: rolling postmortem checklist: - confirm customers still impacted (<1% errors), - capture exact request ids and affected model versions, - schedule oncall+runtime postmortem sync, - propose mitigation (auto-evict heuristics).

jamal_support: current customer impact: errors down to 0.9% in last 5m. status page updated to "Degraded - Mitigated".

incident-bot: PD-784122: Resolved? Not yet. Awaiting confirmation and postmortem owner assignment.

sophie_oncall: assigning postmortem owner: miguel_rtx. Will add findings to incident tracker. Closing mitigation loop now, leaving PD in status 'monitoring' for 2 hours.

miguel_rtx: I'll follow up with quantization team and runtime to add auto-evict to kvcache when alloc-fail spikes. Will create RFC and link here.

tara_sre: leaving note: consider increasing spare-inference-pool baseline in eu-west during peak window to avoid cold burst risk.

sophie_oncall: thanks all. If we see reoccurrence, escalate to infra lead @mira. For now, monitoring. :white_check_mark:
